name: stbarthcommuter.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But HSTS is not sent.
lesson: Send Strict-Transport-Security with a max-age of at least a year, so browsers never try plain http again.
summary: www.stbarthcommuter.com scores 55 out of 100 (D). 8 checks fail now, 32 are at risk, and 28 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 194 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /en/, /en/scheduled-flights.php, /en/private-charter-flights.php, /en/contact.php and 14 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: A cookie banner was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Ads (4 requests), Google Analytics (1 request), and cookies _GRECAPTCHA on www.google.com, YSC on youtube.com, VISITOR_INFO1_LIVE on youtube.com,…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Select element must have an accessible name
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 2 elements on /en/scheduled-flights.php, /en/private-charter-flights.php, for example #currency. Impact: critical.

fix.title: 112 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 46 elements on /en/, /en/scheduled-flights.php, /en/private-charter-flights.php, for example .container > a[target="_blank"] and .my-2:nth-child(6) > a[target="_blank"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 396 ms
Language alternates point at each other
